parsed.why: Statewide gender-identity civil-rights, hate-crime and panic-defence-repeal statutes, accessible marker changes, and a low-risk assessment confined to youth. No adult facility ban documented; national passport and entry regime still applies, capping the gain over parent.

Adult-reaching 2024 birth-sex facility ban in schools and government buildings, enforced via a public reporting form — a universal exposure. Flag ban, minors' care ban, no public-accommodation protection, hate-crime coverage only partially offsets; below parent-plus protections.

First division to strip gender-identity anti-discrimination protection, then preempt local ordinances; school facility rule binds visitors by birth certificate. Placed in worst risk tier for trans adults. No remedy for service refusal; national regime adds document and custody exposure.

Most-Protective tier: public-accommodations, employment and services ban on gender-identity discrimination, shield law for visiting patients, custody and strip-search by recognised gender, open documents. Strong working protections outweigh, but cannot cancel, the national passport and entry regime.

Most-Protective tier with ballot-confirmed public accommodations, self-declared documents and X markers, shield law, functioning hate-crime reporting task force. Latent unrepealed sodomy provisions unenforceable since 1974; national document and entry rules remain the limiting factor.
